roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team members.In this dual-focused position, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, fostering continuous professional growth and competency. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and educating staff on best practices to maintain a safe and healthy environment.This full-time opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are a proactive RN with a passion for education and patient safety, and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education within a healthcare setting
Demonstrated expertise in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.

description: Join a dynamic skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL, as a Marketing Director. This is an exciting opportunity to make a significant impact, especially as the facility has recently been purchased and is poised for growth. We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven individual to lead our marketing efforts and drive census development.In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, cultivating strong relationships with referral sources, and enhancing the facility's presence within the community. The ideal candidate will be a proactive 'hustler' with exceptional presentation skills, capable of representing our facility with professionalism and enthusiasm.This full-time position requires flexibility, including working occasional weekends to meet business needs. We offer competitive compensation for the right person, recognizing the value of a dedicated and effective Marketing Director.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, ideally within a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and build robust community referral networks.
Exceptional presentation and interpersonal communication skills.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as required.
A proactive, results-oriented approach with a strong drive for success.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience. Pays well for the right person.
